recordings.title: Sunday of St. Mary of Egypt

reference_selection.caveat: The dated 2026-03-29 Matins and St. Basil Liturgy correspond to the recording title Sunday of St. Mary of Egypt. The service date is inferred from release/upload metadata and title; local omissions and spoken variants are not independently verified.

The exact 2025-12-28 DCS pages were unavailable. This composite retains the 2026-12-27 same-Sunday layout and feast propers, with official DCS Mode 4, Eothinon 7 (John 20:1–10), and same civil-date commemorations substituted. The 2025 GOARCH calendar and dated parish bulletin support these components. This is a documented reconstruction, not the exact 2025 book; local choices, omitted prayers, and hymn order remain unverified. The Dec27 St Stephen propers are removed and Galatians 1:11–19 restored. The unverified prokeimenon is intentionally uncovered; minor daily hymn variants may still be missing.

The exact 2025-12-14 DCS pages were unavailable. This composite retains the 2026-12-13 same-Sunday layout and feast propers, with official DCS Mode 2, Eothinon 5 (Luke 24:12–35), and same civil-date commemorations substituted. The 2025 GOARCH calendar and dated parish bulletin support these components. This is a documented reconstruction, not the exact 2025 book; local choices, omitted prayers, and hymn order remain unverified.
